name: Thexar
description: An Anaba minotaur of Ulgrotha who died in a ritual scarring ceremony gone wrong.

timeline.summary: Arras tends the dying Thexar, wiping away blood and offering comfort.
timeline.quote: He knelt beside Thexar, tenderly wiping away the blood and offering comforting words.

citation.text: "Arras", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arras tells stories of past warriors to distract Thexar from his pain.
timeline.quote: Arras sought to distract Thexar from his pain, using tales of past warriors and battles to offer solace

citation.text: "Arras", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The scarring ritual meant to mark Thexar's adulthood goes tragically wrong, threatening his life.
timeline.quote: put her in a difficult position when the ritual went tragically wrong.

timeline.summary: Neth'arna declares Thexar's death imminent; he pleads for death and accuses her.
timeline.quote: Her practical and somber declaration of Thexar's impending death

timeline.summary: Thexar led his group to their ancestral caverns with his navigational skill.
